Rowan Atkinson to Revive Blackadder and Mr. Bean Characters

Actor Rowan Atkinson is set to revive his iconic characters Blackadder and Mr. Bean in a new show. This marks the return of Blackadder after decades, and Atkinson's first West End comedy sketch show in 40 years.
